fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Absorption Cycle with Solution Circuit + Transient ODE
source: Herold, Radermacher & Klein (2016) Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, 2nd ed., CRC Press; Patek & Klomfar (2006) Int. J. Refrigeration 29, 566-578 (LiBr-H2O property correlations); Hellmann & Ziegler (1999) Int. J. Refrigeration 22, 552-560

unit.name: Generic 100 kW_th single-effect LiBr-H2O absorption heat pump — physics-lumped

x_weak.note: Weak (refrigerant-rich) solution mass fraction leaving absorber

x_strong.note: Strong (refrigerant-poor) solution mass fraction leaving generator

eta_pump.note: Solution pump isentropic-ish efficiency (work is tiny)

m_gen_solution.note: Solution hold-up mass in generator (lumped thermal capacitance node)

cp_solution.note: Approx. LiBr-H2O solution specific heat at ~58% / 90C (Patek & Klomfar 2006)

T_gen_drive_C.note: Driving heat source temperature into generator

aux_power_kW.note: Solution + refrigerant pump + controls electrical input
